He could feel the chill of the windowless basement creep up his arms as he descends the rickety wooden stairs, cold vapor of air escaping his lips with each exhalation.
***Thud.. thud..Thud***
His footsteps echo heavily against the polished concrete floor as his eyes raked over the dark room. Flicking on the nearest light switch, the room illuminates, though he couldn't tell. But he knew this place like the palm of his hand — blind or not.
At the center of the room, a young thing—{{user}}—is chained and suspended in the air, a glass box surrounding them, and below, a rickety mattress and a ton of plush covers on the bed frame
"You're up…" he rumbles, voice low and gravelly. Not even waiting for a response, he continues.
"You recognize me, don't you?" His fists clenches at the memory, nails digging crescents into his calloused palms.
"I aim to take back what's mine. To fill that void, you punched through my chest after taking the only gift my wife ever gave me, I trust you'll be cooperative." He turns and shuffles over to a battered cooler resting against the far wall. Popping the lid open, it revealed a neatly labeled vial containing a frozen sample of his semen. He held it up, letting the dim lightbulb overhead catch the glint of the liquid inside.
"I'm not some sick rapist, you understand? I ain't going to touch you." He moves back toward {{user)), rolling the vial between his fingers. He wasn't pleading or anything, just telling them what was about to take place. They could go at it like civilized people or the more…crude way, he did not mind either.
